records.note: The identity question is materially narrower than the earlier artifact stated. Nevada's current tobacco-retail list independently carries RED DRAGON SPORTS BAR #201 at the same address. Elko City Council minutes show the regular retail liquor license issued to the DBA Red Dragon Sports Bar #201 and state that the project was open; Nevada Gaming Commission disposition approved the nonrestricted slot-machine license for that same DBA/address. The 2025-2026 official Elko visitor guide markets the same address as Red Drag Casino, while current casino-directory material identifies Red Dragon Sports Bar #201 and also lists Dotty's #214 at the identical address. That pattern supports Red Dragon as the operating property identity and Red Drag as a consumer/tourism alias; Dotty's appears to be a co-located Nevada Restaurant Services concept rather than evidence that Red Dragon ceased operating. No numerical coordinate has yet cleared the direct parcel/building-point gate, and runtime should also avoid accidental duplicate emission of co-located concepts until the intended destination treatment is explicit. The previously recorded 40.8286,-115.7634 values remain excluded as unsupported.
